INSERT INTO users (
  channel,
  channel_user_id,
  username,
  first_name,
  last_name,
  language_code,
  updated_at
)
VALUES (
  '{{ $json.user.channel }}',
  '{{ $json.user.channel_user_id }}',
  '{{ $json.user.username }}',
  '{{ $json.user.first_name }}',
  '{{ $json.user.last_name }}',
  '{{ $json.user.language_code }}',
  CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
)
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
  username = VALUES(username),
  first_name = VALUES(first_name),
  last_name = VALUES(last_name),
  language_code = VALUES(language_code),
  updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP;

SELECT *
FROM users
WHERE channel = '{{ $("Normalize Telegram Input").first().json.user.channel }}'
  AND channel_user_id = '{{ $("Normalize Telegram Input").first().json.user.channel_user_id }}'
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  COALESCE(s.id, '') AS session_id,
  COALESCE(s.user_id, '') AS session_user_id,
  COALESCE(s.channel, '') AS channel,
  COALESCE(s.channel_chat_id, '') AS channel_chat_id,
  COALESCE(s.status, '') AS session_status,
  COALESCE(s.locked, 0) AS session_locked,
  COALESCE(s.active_service, '') AS active_service,
  COALESCE(s.current_step, '') AS current_step,
  COALESCE(s.last_intent, '') AS last_intent,
  COALESCE(s.last_message_type, '') AS last_message_type,
  COALESCE(s.context_json, JSON_OBJECT()) AS context_json,
  CASE
    WHEN s.id IS NULL THEN 0
    ELSE 1
  END AS has_active_session
FROM (SELECT 1) x
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT *
  FROM user_sessions
  WHERE user_id = '{{ $("Attach DB User To Request").first().json.user.id }}'
    AND locked = 1
    AND status IN (
      'active',
      'waiting_for_file',
      'waiting_for_job_description',
      'waiting_for_match_inputs',
      'waiting_for_confirmation'
    )
  ORDER BY updated_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
) s ON 1 = 1;

UPDATE user_sessions
SET
  status = 'cancelled',
  locked = 0,
  active_service = NULL,
  closed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
WHERE user_id = '{{ $json.user.id }}'
  AND locked = 1;

UPDATE user_sessions
SET
  status = 'cancelled',
  locked = 0,
  closed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
WHERE id > 0
  AND user_id = '{{ $json.user.id }}'
  AND status = 'active';

INSERT INTO user_sessions (
  user_id,
  channel,
  channel_chat_id,
  status,
  locked,
  active_service,
  current_step,
  last_intent,
  last_message_type,
  context_json,
  expires_at,
  created_at,
  updated_at
)
VALUES (
  {{ Number($json.user.id) }},
  '{{ $json.channel }}',
  '{{ $json.meta.chat_id }}',
  '{{ $json.session_start.status }}',
  {{ Number($json.session_start.locked) }},
  '{{ $json.session_start.service }}',
  '{{ $json.session_start.current_step }}',
  '{{ $json.route.requested_service }}',
  '{{ $json.input.type }}',
  CAST('{{ $json.session_start.context_json_sql }}' AS JSON),
  DATE_ADD(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INTERVAL 2 HOUR),
  CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

SELECT *
FROM user_sessions
WHERE user_id = {{ Number($("Restore Route Plan Context").first().json.user.id) }}
  AND status = 'active'
  AND locked = 1
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 1;
